label: Strong ordered variant and recipient willing exclude non-rational caused effects
meaning: Analyst formulation. At ONE RecipientGoodWilling W (the bridge instantiated at W.WillsGoodFor): for a distinct, non-rational, actual x whose esse a GOD_4 with will causes, a94c5dfc gives that g wills x's good to x, and the strong variant denies it. Hence such an x cannot exist if both hold. The two statements are therefore jointly incompatible with any GOD_4 with will causing the esse of a distinct non-rational being in act; this does not say which to reject. The weak ordered reading has no such conflict.

strong_version_needed.1dd68893-7e41-4909-9f17-1dbb342a7d95: The proof uses the second conjunct (And.right), that GOD_4 does not will the recipient good for x (¬ W.WillsGoodFor g x esse), to exclude non-rational caused effects. The weak version OrderedExistenceWillingWeak (7f6a2e91) keeps only the ordered-willing conjunct and neither asserts nor denies recipient willing.
